options.why: Side $b$ runs from $A$ to $C$, so it meets angle $A$ rather than lying opposite it.

questions.question_text: In $\triangle MNO$, which side is opposite angle $N$?

options.why: $m$ is the side opposite angle $M$, not angle $N$.
$o$ is the side opposite angle $O$, not angle $N$.

questions.solution_text:
By the naming convention, the side opposite an angle takes the lowercase form of that angle's letter.
The side opposite angle $N$ is $n$.
